module.name: @spark-appworks/spark-lowcode-api:platform/lowcode-application
module.jsdoc:
低代码应用目录与导航根查询：DataOperation.GetData 请求体构造与响应归一化。
wire 行字段大小写混用（rowid/ROWID、AppName/appName 等），归一化层负责别名兼容。

LowcodeApplication.name: LowcodeApplication
LowcodeApplication.jsdoc:
归一化后的应用条目；id 为 Base_AppSystemList.rowid。
可选目录元信息仅在正式来源返回且当前调用可读时提供；缺省表示未知/不可用，不从登录会话补造归属。

attributes.name: code
attributes.jsdoc: Formal AppName value when returned and readable.

attributes.name: description
attributes.jsdoc: Formal AppDesc value when returned and readable.

attributes.name: enterpriseId
attributes.jsdoc: Formal EntId value when returned and readable; never inferred from session identity.

attributes.name: enterpriseShortName
attributes.jsdoc: Formal EntShortName value when returned and readable; never inferred from session identity.

attributes.name: isDefault
attributes.jsdoc: True/false only for a readable formal IsSys value of 1/0; undefined means unknown, not false.
